Guidelines for contributors and AI agents working on gghoneycomb.

R Package Development Workflow

Infrastructure Changes

Use usethis::use_*() functions for all infrastructure modifications: - usethis::use_package("pkg") - add runtime dependency - usethis::use_package("pkg", type = "Suggests") - add dev dependency - usethis::use_test("feature") - create test file - usethis::use_r("feature") - create R source file

Core Commands

devtools::load_all()    # Load package for interactive testing
devtools::document()    # Regenerate NAMESPACE and man/*.Rd from roxygen2
devtools::test()        # Run testthat tests
devtools::check()       # Full R CMD check

Hands-Off Files

Never edit manually: - NAMESPACE - generated by roxygen2 - man/*.Rd - generated by roxygen2

These files are regenerated by devtools::document(). All documentation lives in roxygen2 comments (#') in R source files.

ggplot2 Extension Conventions

ggproto Inheritance

  • Inherit from appropriate ggplot2 classes: Geom, Stat, Scale, etc.
  • Use ggproto("GeomHoneycomb", Geom, ...) pattern
  • Override only necessary methods; rely on parent defaults

Dependencies

  • Use Imports (not Depends) for ggplot2 and other packages
  • Access ggplot2 internals via ggplot2:: prefix
  • Use @importFrom rlang .data for tidy evaluation (avoids R CMD check NOTEs)

Tidy Evaluation

#' @importFrom rlang .data

Use .data$column in aes mappings and dplyr operations to avoid undefined global variable warnings.

Testing Approach

Start Simple

  1. Data-based tests first: Test that stats/geoms produce expected data structures
  2. Use layer_data(): Extract computed data from ggplot objects for assertions
  3. Test edge cases: Empty data, single row, NA handling

Visual Testing

Add vdiffr only when: - Visual output is critical to the feature - Data-based tests cannot capture the behavior - You have stable reference images

# Only if needed:
usethis::use_package("vdiffr", type = "Suggests")

renv Policy

Configuration

  • snapshot.type = "explicit" - only captures DESCRIPTION dependencies
  • renv.lock is git-ignored - CI installs from DESCRIPTION

Workflow

# After adding/changing dependencies:
renv::snapshot(dev = TRUE)

# Sync local environment:
renv::restore()

# Check status:
renv::status()

Why dev = TRUE?

renv::snapshot(dev = TRUE) includes Suggests dependencies in the lockfile, ensuring dev tools (testthat, knitr, etc.) are captured for local development.

Quick Reference

Task Command
Add runtime dep usethis::use_package("pkg")
Add dev dep usethis::use_package("pkg", type = "Suggests")
Update docs devtools::document()
Run tests devtools::test()
Full check devtools::check()
Update lockfile renv::snapshot(dev = TRUE)
Restore env renv::restore()
